title: Impact of Recent Recall of EVs on Singapore Car Owners
what_it_is: Impact of Recent Recall of EVs on Singapore Car Owners

sections.label: BYD vehicles not affected
sections.summary: BYD Singapore told LTA that BYD vehicles sold in Singapore are not affected by a recall of about 97,000 BYD vehicles made in China.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: BYD Singapore Private Limited has informed LTA that BYD vehicles sold in Singapore, are not affected by the recent recall affecting about 97,000 BYD vehicles manufactured in China.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: LTA will continue to monitor the situation and will take appropriate action if any safety concerns are identified.

sections.label: Vehicle safety standards and recalls
sections.summary: All vehicles must meet international safety standards and periodic inspections, and dealers must report safety recalls and notify affected owners.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: All vehicles, including EVs, are required to meet internationally recognised vehicle safety standards, such as the United Nations regulations, before they can be used on our roads.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: All vehicles are also required to undergo periodic inspections, to ensure that they meet roadworthiness requirements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: LTA does not conduct additional testing and inspection for vehicles affected in recalls, but requires motor dealers to promptly report any safety-related recalls initiated by vehicle manufacturers to LTA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: Once reported, dealers are provided with the contact details of the affected vehicle owners.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: Motor dealers must then notify these owners and make arrangements to rectify the defects as soon as possible.
